messages.content:
Plan this as a Rhylthyme protocol and deliver a live timeline: Western Blot: SDS-PAGE, Wet Transfer and Overnight Primary for one 10-lane gel, one membrane, following the source text below
Resource limits: one gel tank, one wet transfer tank, one orbital rocker, one tray at a time, one cold room, one chemiluminescence imager, one operator.
Steps:
1. Check the public catalog first (search_public_recipes or run_protocol). If a good match exists, use it and stop — its result already has the live URL.
2. Otherwise read rhylthyme://guide/authoring and build a program: one track per parallel line of work, sequential steps chained with afterStep, realistic durations, and a resourceConstraint for every task.
3. Express the limits as constraints, not as copied JSON. A machine that runs one job at a time is `resourceConstraints[].maxConcurrent`. Work repeated n times (n trays, n samples, n aircraft) is `replicates: {count: n, mode: "serial" | "parallel" | "stagger"}` on ONE step — never n hand-copied steps or tracks. Chain what follows each repetition with `{"type":"afterStep","stepId":"<step>","instances":"each"}`, and give the step that waits for all of them `"instances":"all"`. When a holding area between them only fits k at a time (a rack that holds two trays, a rotor that holds six tubes, a taxiway that holds two aircraft), set `replicates.maxInFlight: k` so the upstream step is held back instead of stranding the downstream one.
4. Run validate_program and fix every error it reports.
5. Run analyze_schedule to check the makespan, critical path and resource conflicts; adjust offsets so tracks finish together. Its `bindingConstraints` say which limit is actually gating the makespan.
6. Call visualize_schedule and give the user the live URL plus the Gantt/itinerary from the result. Do not describe the schedule in prose.

Source text to schedule (read all of it):
<<<
Western Blot: SDS-PAGE, Wet Transfer and Overnight Primary

One 10-well precast gel is run, wet-transferred to PVDF and probed overnight. The bench has one gel tank, one wet transfer tank, one orbital rocker that takes a single tray, a heat block, a microcentrifuge, a cold room and one chemiluminescence imager. The transfer tank and the rocker are the two things nothing else can share, so the blot moves through them one stage at a time.

Sample preparation
1. Thaw the lysates on ice and normalise them to 2 mg/mL; 15 minutes.
2. Add 4× Laemmli buffer and denature at 95 °C for 5 minutes in the heat block.
3. Spin the tubes for 2 minutes in the microcentrifuge to collect condensate.

Gel
4. Assemble the tank, seat the precast gel and fill with running buffer; 10 minutes.
5. Load 20 µg per lane and 5 µL of protein ladder; 10 minutes. Nothing is loaded until the denatured samples have been spun down.
6. Run at 120 V for 75 minutes, until the dye front reaches the foot of the gel.

Transfer preparation
7. Put a litre of transfer buffer in the cold room an hour before you need it.
8. One hour into the run, wet a PVDF membrane in methanol for 30 seconds and equilibrate it in transfer buffer; 5 minutes.
9. Soak the fibre pads and filter paper in cold transfer buffer; 10 minutes.

Blot
10. Five minutes after the run ends, prise the gel out of the cassette and build the transfer sandwich with no bubbles; 10 minutes.
11. Transfer at 100 V for 60 minutes with an ice pack in the tank.
12. Stain the membrane with Ponceau S, photograph it and rinse it off; 10 minutes.
13. Block in 5 % milk on the rocker for 1 hour at room temperature.
14. Probe with primary antibody overnight in the cold room; 12 to 18 hours.
15. Wash three times for 10 minutes each on the rocker.
16. Probe with HRP-conjugated secondary on the rocker for 1 hour.
17. Wash three times for 10 minutes each on the rocker.

Detection
18. Fifty minutes into the secondary, mix the ECL substrate; 5 minutes.
19. Drain the membrane, apply the substrate and let it work for 5 minutes.
20. Image the blot; 10 minutes of exposures.
21. Quantify the bands against the loading control; 15 minutes.
>>>

{
  "schemaVersion": "0.3.0-alpha",
  "programId": "western-blot-protocol",
  "name": "Western Blot: SDS-PAGE, Wet Transfer and Overnight Primary",
  "description": "Standard Western Blot protocol: SDS-PAGE, wet transfer, and overnight antibody incubation.",
  "environmentType": "laboratory",
  "actors": 1,
  "tracks": [
    {
      "trackId": "sample-prep",
      "name": "Sample Preparation",
      "steps": [
        { "stepId": "thaw", "name": "Thaw and normalize", "task": "bench", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 900 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "programStart" } },
        { "stepId": "denature", "name": "Heat block denature", "task": "heat-block", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 300 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "thaw" } },
        { "stepId": "spin", "name": "Spin down", "task": "microcentrifuge", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 120 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "denature" } }
      ]
    },
    {
      "trackId": "gel-work",
      "name": "Gel and Transfer",
      "steps": [
        { "stepId": "buffer-prep", "name": "Chill buffer", "task": "cold-room", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 3600 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "programStart" } },
        { "stepId": "assemble", "name": "Assemble tank", "task": "gel-tank", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 600 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "programStart" } },
        { "stepId": "load", "name": "Load gel", "task": "gel-tank", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 600 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "spin" } },
        { "stepId": "run", "name": "Run gel", "task": "gel-tank", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 4500 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "load" } },
        { "stepId": "prep-membrane", "name": "Prep membrane", "task": "bench", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 300 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "programStartOffset", "offsetSeconds": 3600 } },
        { "stepId": "prep-pads", "name": "Soak pads", "task": "bench", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 600 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "prep-membrane" } },
        { "stepId": "sandwich", "name": "Build sandwich", "task": "transfer-tank", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 600 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "run", "offsetSeconds": 300 } },
        { "stepId": "transfer", "name": "Transfer", "task": "transfer-tank", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 3600 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "sandwich" } },
        { "stepId": "ponceau", "name": "Stain/Photo", "task": "bench", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 600 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "transfer" } },
        { "stepId": "block", "name": "Block", "task": "rocker", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 3600 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "ponceau" } },
        { "stepId": "primary", "name": "Primary antibody", "task": "cold-room", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 54000 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "block" } },
        { "stepId": "wash1", "name": "Wash 1", "task": "rocker", "replicates": { "count": 3, "mode": "serial" }, "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 600 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "primary" } },
        { "stepId": "secondary", "name": "Secondary antibody", "task": "rocker", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 3600 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "wash1", "instances": "all" } },
        { "stepId": "wash2", "name": "Wash 2", "task": "rocker", "replicates": { "count": 3, "mode": "serial" }, "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 600 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "secondary" } },
        { "stepId": "ecl-mix", "name": "Mix ECL", "task": "bench", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 300 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "secondary", "offsetSeconds": 3000 } },
        { "stepId": "ecl-incubation", "name": "ECL incubation", "task": "bench", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 300 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "compound", "logic": "all", "triggers": [{ "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "wash2", "instances": "all" }, { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "ecl-mix" }] } },
        { "stepId": "image", "name": "Image", "task": "imager", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 600 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "ecl-incubation" } },
        { "stepId": "analyze", "name": "Analyze", "task": "bench", "duration": { "type": "fixed", "seconds": 900 }, "startTrigger": { "type": "afterStep", "stepId": "image" } }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "bench", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "heat-block", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "microcentrifuge", "maxConcurrent": 1 },

    { "task": "rocker", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "cold-room", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "imager", "maxConcurrent": 1 }
  ]
}
